name: suarify
description: AI voice calling for businesses — place outbound calls, manage agents and leads, top up prepaid credit.

interface.shortDescription: Place AI voice calls, manage agents & leads, top up credit.
interface.longDescription: Suarify connects ChatGPT to your Suarify prepaid voice account. Place interactive or broadcast outbound calls (default Gemini / Sulafat), schedule campaigns, manage AI agents and leads, review call logs, and generate a Stripe top-up link for your profile. Sign in with Google or email OTP via OAuth — each tool call runs as your own Suarify account.
